subject: general
question: Which state is the leading producer of cotton in India, as of April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gujarat is the largest producer of cotton.
 
• Cotton is one of the most important cash crops and accounts for around 25% of the total global fiber production.
 
• Cotton is also grown in the States of Tamil Nadu and Odisha.
 
• Cotton grows in warm climates.
 
• Black soil is most suitable for the growth of cotton as it has the capacity to hold a lot of moisture.
 
• Black soils are poor in nitrogen, phosphorus, and organic matter.
 
• Black soil is also called lava soil or regur soil.​
